label: August 3–9, 2026
intro: This weekend offers world-class pantomime in Bangkok AND a colourful balloon festival by Pranburi beach — plus NSM Brain Inside Out is in its final days.

activities.title: Pantomime in Bangkok 2026
activities.time: Multiple show times — check venue for schedule
activities.location: Muang Thai Life Assurance Auditorium, Ratchadaphisek Road, Bangkok
activities.why: World-class pantomime artists bring silent storytelling, slapstick humour, and audience participation — Thor will howl at the physical comedy. Interactive workshops alongside the shows mean he gets to be part of the performance.
activities.tip: Book tickets in advance. Matinée shows work best for 5-year-old energy levels.

activities.title: Mini Balloon Festival @ Pranburi — Beach Day Trip
activities.location: Lan Maharaj, Pak Nam Pran, Pranburi, Prachuap Khiri Khan (3 hrs south of Bangkok)
activities.price: Free entry; food and activities extra
activities.why: Colourful mini hot-air balloons glowing against the night sky, live music, and fresh seafood by the beach. Thor will love spotting the balloons rise at dusk — the perfect first balloon festival.
activities.tip: Go Friday or Saturday to avoid Sunday crowds. Combine with an overnight beach stay for a full weekend escape.

activities.title: NSM 'Brain Inside Out' Exhibition — Last 10 Days
activities.location: National Science Museum (NSM), Technopolis, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani
activities.why: Hands-on brain science for little builders — Thor explores how the brain works through interactive exhibits. Running out of time: exhibition closes August 13.
activities.tip: Tuesday or Wednesday morning is the quietest. Combine with Bangkok Planetarium at Ekkamai for a full science day.

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Regular Sessions
activities.location: Sub-Zero Sukhumvit-Ekkamai (BTS Ekkamai) or Sub-Zero Mega Bangna
activities.price: ~200 THB adults / 100 THB children; 90-min session ~260 THB incl. skates & helmet
activities.why: Thor loves ice skating — Sub-Zero's beginner-friendly rink with helmet included is perfect. Great cool escape from August heat.
activities.tip: Weekday mornings are the quietest. The Academy Rink offers beginner lessons — worth booking one.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Rollerblading Sessions
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Shopping Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (BTS Phrom Phong)
activities.price: ~150–200 THB per session incl. skate rental
activities.why: Indoor air-conditioned rink, perfect size for a 5-year-old learning to rollerblade. Smooth floor, helpful staff, BTS-accessible.
activities.tip: Call ahead on weekends to check for private events (0646471800). The smaller rink suits beginners well.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic & Pottery Workshop
activities.date: Multiple sessions weekly — book at classbento.co.th
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.why: Thor loved pottery class! ClassBento runs bookable kids' ceramic sessions: pinch pots, slabs, coils — he makes and decorates his own piece. Minimum age 5, which Thor just hits.
activities.tip: Book 2–3 days ahead. Saturday morning sessions fill fastest. Kids take their creations home.

activities.title: WOW Park Science Museum — 40+ Interactive Exhibits
activities.price: Approx. 350–500 THB; up to 45% off via Klook or KKday
activities.why: 40+ hands-on science exhibits Thor can touch, try, and experiment with — tornado simulators, optical illusions, physics demos. Perfect for the building & making interest.
activities.tip: Book via Klook for the best price. Combine WOW Park + Sub-Zero ice skating (both at Gateway Ekamai) for an easy full day.

activities.title: Children's Discovery Museum — Free Entry
activities.why: Hands-on science, technology, nature, and art exhibits for under-12s. Free family workshops run regularly. Thor can explore, build, and discover with zero budget pressure.
activities.tip: Best on a weekday when school groups are fewer. Pair with a walk in Chatuchak Park afterwards.
